# Appwrite Integrations

> Guides for connecting Appwrite to third-party tools and platforms.

Append `.md` to any integration URL, or open the links below, to receive the raw Markdown source.

- [Auth Kit for FlutterFlow](https://appwrite.io/integrations/flutterflow-auth-kit.md): Integrate Appwrite Auth into your FlutterFlow apps without writing complex code
- [Data replication with RxDB](https://appwrite.io/integrations/replication-rxdb.md): Setup push-pull replication from a local database and enable offline sync capabilities using RxDB
- [Deploy a CRM Dashboard with React Admin on Sites](https://appwrite.io/integrations/sites-react-admin.md): Build and deploy a full-featured CRM dashboard with React Admin on Appwrite Sites
- [Deploy Docusaurus with Sites](https://appwrite.io/integrations/sites-docusaurus.md): Build an MDX-powered documentation site with Appwrite Sites
- [Deploy Magic Portfolio with Sites](https://appwrite.io/integrations/sites-magic-portfolio.md): Showcase your creative work with a customizable portfolio with Appwrite Sites
- [Deploy Nxtlnk with Sites](https://appwrite.io/integrations/sites-nxtlnk.md): Build a custom bio links page with Appwrite Sites
- [Deploy Starlight with Sites](https://appwrite.io/integrations/sites-starlight.md): Create a Astro-based documentation site with Appwrite Sites
- [Deploy VuePress with Sites](https://appwrite.io/integrations/sites-vuepress.md): Create a Vue-based documentation site with Appwrite Sites
- [Deployments with GitHub](https://appwrite.io/integrations/deployments-github.md): Manage versions and deploy Appwrite Functions
- [Email with SendGrid](https://appwrite.io/integrations/email-sendgrid.md): Send customized emails to your users
- [Image classification with Hugging Face](https://appwrite.io/integrations/ai-hugging-face-image-classification.md): Understand and label the contents of images
- [Language translation with Hugging Face](https://appwrite.io/integrations/ai-hugging-face-language-translation.md): Translate text between languages
- [Logging with AppSignal](https://appwrite.io/integrations/logging-appsignal.md): Monitor application health in real time, store logs and track issues on your Appwrite instance with the help of AppSignal intergration.
- [Logging with Raygun](https://appwrite.io/integrations/logging-raygun.md): Integrate Raygun, an application performane monitoring (APM) tool with Appwrite to diagnose and fix errors quicker.
- [Logging with Sentry](https://appwrite.io/integrations/logging-sentry.md): Connect Sentry to your self-hosted Appwrite instance for improved error-tracking, logging, and overall reliability of your application.
- [MCP with Claude](https://appwrite.io/integrations/mcp-claude.md): Connect to Appwrite project with the MCP within Claude Desktop.
- [MCP with Cursor](https://appwrite.io/integrations/mcp-cursor.md): Connect to Appwrite project with the MCP within Cursor.
- [MCP with Windsurf](https://appwrite.io/integrations/mcp-windsurf.md): Connect to Appwrite project with the MCP within Windsurf Editor.
- [Native auth with Apple](https://appwrite.io/integrations/native-auth-apple.md): Integrate native auth on Apple devices with Appwrite Auth
- [OAuth with Amazon](https://appwrite.io/integrations/oauth-amazon.md): Authenticate users with an existing Amazon account
- [OAuth with Apple](https://appwrite.io/integrations/oauth-apple.md): Authenticate users with an existing Apple account
- [OAuth with Discord](https://appwrite.io/integrations/oauth-discord.md): Authenticate users with an existing Discord account
- [OAuth with Google](https://appwrite.io/integrations/oauth-google.md): Authenticate users with an existing Google account
- [OAuth with Notion](https://appwrite.io/integrations/oauth-notion.md): Authenticate users with an existing Notion account
- [OAuth with X](https://appwrite.io/integrations/oauth-x.md): Authenticate users with an existing X account
- [Payments with Lemon Squeezy](https://appwrite.io/integrations/lemon-squeezy-payments.md): Connect Lemon Squeezy to Appwrite to handle payments, manage orders, generate invoices, and simplify your operations.
- [Payments with Stripe](https://appwrite.io/integrations/stripe-payments.md): Integrate Stripe with Appwrite to accept payments, store orders, manage invoices, and streamline your business operations.
- [Phone auth with Twilio](https://appwrite.io/integrations/phone-auth-twilio.md): Authenticate users via OTPs sent through SMS using Twilio
- [Prompt ChatGPT](https://appwrite.io/integrations/ai-openai.md): Send text prompts to OpenAI GPT-3.5 and receive text generations
- [Prompt Perplexity](https://appwrite.io/integrations/ai-perplexity.md): Send text prompts to Perplexity and receive text generations
- [Push notifications with APNs](https://appwrite.io/integrations/push-apns.md): Integrate Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) with Appwrite Messaging to send remote notifications to your users' Apple devices.
- [Push notifications with FCM](https://appwrite.io/integrations/push-fcm.md): Integrate Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) with Appwrite to send push notifications to iOS, Android and web applications.
- [Query MongoDB Atlas](https://appwrite.io/integrations/query-mongodb.md): Save a document in your MongoDB cluster and list all stored documents
- [Query Upstash](https://appwrite.io/integrations/query-upstash.md): Store data in your Upstash vector database and query it for similar data
- [Search with Algolia](https://appwrite.io/integrations/search-algolia.md): Integrate Algolia search into your Appwrite database
- [Self-host Appwrite with MongoDB](https://appwrite.io/integrations/self-hosted-mongodb.md): Use MongoDB as the underlying database for your self-hosted Appwrite instance.
- [SMS with Twilio](https://appwrite.io/integrations/sms-twilio.md): Send customized SMS messages to your users
- [Speech recognition with Hugging Face](https://appwrite.io/integrations/ai-hugging-face-speech-recognition.md): Process speech audio into text
- [Storage with Amazon S3](https://appwrite.io/integrations/storage-s3.md): Store files in Amazon S3 instead of your local storage device
- [Subscriptions with Lemon Squeezy](https://appwrite.io/integrations/lemon-squeezy-subscriptions.md): Connect Lemon Squeezy subscriptions service to Appwrite to receive and manage recurring payments in your application.
- [Subscriptions with Stripe](https://appwrite.io/integrations/stripe-subscriptions.md): Integrate Stripe subscriptions with Appwrite to accept and manage recurring payments from your customers.
- [Terraform provider for Appwrite](https://appwrite.io/integrations/terraform-provider.md): Manage Appwrite TablesDB, Storage, Auth, Functions, Sites, Messaging, webhooks, backups, and more with HashiCorp Terraform and the official appwrite/appwrite provider.
- [Text to speech with ElevenLabs](https://appwrite.io/integrations/ai-elevenlabs-text-to-speech.md): Transform text into natural, human-like speech
- [WhatsApp with Vonage](https://appwrite.io/integrations/whatsapp-vonage.md): Send automated replies to messages on WhatsApp
